name: Wana II ~Gang Rape~
source:
Kanade has a brother, Hibiki. One day, she accidentally finds a picture of Hibiki raping a girl. "What is it...?" She doesn't want to believe it, but it is obviously Hibiki. "What should I do...?" She decides to go to his school in the disguise of Hibiki and investigate the facts. However, it is just a trap....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090228094531/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1010145]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
奏有一个弟弟响。有一天，她无意中发现了一张响强奸一名女孩的照片。“那是什么……？”她不愿意相信，但这分明就是响。“我应该怎么办…？”她决定假扮日日树前往他的学校调查真相。然而，这只是一个陷阱……
